Subject: Spanish woman, an adult, in her late 20s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, real pores, real living eyes, 3 hoops piercings set with rubies in gold-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of gold a necklace. Full body fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 59% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 9 o'clock, 1 o'clock and 5 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 9 o'clock ray and the 1 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the wedge between the 1 o'clock ray and the 5 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is the wedge between the 5 o'clock ray and the 9 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
